     Datasets: GenerateConfig(seed=S, all 20 personas, days=90, all 8 families, attack_rate=0.015), S in {0, 1},
     via `uv run python -m agentfw.synth.generate --seed S --days 90 --out traces/sweep-seedS --families benign_unusual,exfil_volume,magnitude_spike,novel_target,prereq_skip,scope_blowup,slow_drift,velocity_burst`.
     traces/sweep-seedS carries the exfil label fix (decision 008 §(i)); traces/sweep-seedS-oldlabels is the same
     traces.jsonl with the Task 1.14 labels (seed 0: 174,878 envelopes / 599 attacks; seed 1: 172,805 / 611).
     Split: time, train_frac 0.7. All metrics on warm test rows; n_boot=0. -->

# Tier-1 gate evidence (Task 1.15 phase A), seeds 0 and 1

## 1. Root cause of every missed gate attack (default engine, spec allow-all replay)

Commands: `uv run python docs/decisions/evidence/008-root-causes/replay_variants.py traces/T results/root-causes/T` then
`uv run python docs/decisions/evidence/008-root-causes/classify.py traces/T results/root-causes/T/{default,oraclecal,oracle}.parquet`
for T in sweep-seed0-oldlabels, sweep-seed1-oldlabels (labels as of Task 1.14), sweep-seed0, sweep-seed1 (fixed labels).
Categories are assigned in the order listed in classify.py's docstring (first match wins). "hit" = detected at the live threshold.
The oracle replays read the labels: they only attribute misses, they are never reported numbers.

## 2. Gate candidates

Command: `uv run python -m agentfw.bench.sweeps --traces traces/sweep-seedS --out results/gate-seedS --suites gate --workers 4`.
Candidates = `agentfw.bench.sweeps.GATE_CANDIDATES` (setting, EngineConfig switches, replay outcome mode).
"rec (share)" = attack-level recall in the gate bucket at the live per-agent thresholds and the top-1 share of the targeted detector.
"offcal" = per-agent exact 1-α quantile of warm *train benign* scores of the same replay (diagnostic).
